title: Preparation of 0.5 M EDTA (0.5 L)
author: Haven Himmighoefer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ks7cwhn
materials: Ethylenediamine Tetraacetic Acid Disodium Salt Dihydrate
Once at pH 8, fill to 500 mL.

steps.title: Add deionized water
steps.instruction: Fill a 0.5 L bottle with 300 mL of deionized water.

steps.title: Dissolve EDTA
steps.instruction: Add 95.05 g of Ethylenediamine Tetraacetic Acid Disodium Salt Dihydrate to the water and mix until fully dissolved (initial pH ≈ 3).

steps.title: Adjust pH with NaOH
steps.instruction: Add NaOH pellets (approximately 105 pellets) until the solution pH reaches 8, confirming with a pH meter or pH paper.

steps.title: Autoclave solution
steps.instruction: Place the bottle in an autoclave, add water to the autoclave container to prevent boiling over, and run the cycle at setting 12.
